simpler.evidence: design.md decisions 1–2 weigh imdb_id matching (Kinopoisk new releases often have no imdb_id; fixtures BEAST and FOREST), the core's original-title hash (fails on transliteration and remakes), titles for every row card (hundreds of requests), lookup under pending() in the same build (holds Main and needs a second wait round), and reusing the lastEpisode title (a second write path for `t`). Resolving at open time would need card data that the memory does not keep. Each simpler option fails a scenario or a stated goal; the chosen design reuses resolveTitle and its 7-day cache.
